execution_limitation: Connector has no function-execution action; no browser automation used.
scope: Native-template sender plus two Booking Won call sites only. Other notification functions and Quotation preview unchanged.
dedup: Unique Communications.Dedup_Key from module/record/template/stable event. Booking stage history captured before side effects; non-booking callers may pass event_id, otherwise source Modified_Time is used.
recovery: Existing requests never resend automatically, including Queued and Failed. Sending left after a crash requires manual review. Archive helper reads native email by confirmed message ID and never sends.
validation_next: Call notif_sendLoggedTemplate in preview mode, then record_only using a distinct TEST event_id. Check Queued record and duplicate result before a controlled send.
